summary_en: Ifuji Sangyo executed a block buyback of up to 500,000 shares (6.1% of shares outstanding) at ¥1,738 per share via ToSTNeT-3 on November 10, 2026, for a maximum outlay of ¥869 million, to enable flexible capital policy in response to changing business conditions.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Repurchase via Off-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On November 9, 2026, Ifuji Sangyo's board of directors authorized the acquisition of treasury stock via off-hours trading on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The company executed a block repurchase on November 10, 2026, purchasing up to 500,000 shares at ¥1,738 per share, representing 6.1% of shares outstanding (calculated from 8,163,818 shares outstanding excluding treasury stock as of September 30, 2026). The maximum total consideration is ¥869 million. The buyback is conducted through ToSTNeT-3, the exchange's dedicated off-hours trading system, with the buy order limited to the designated trading session on November 10 at 8:45 a.m. JST.

The company stated the purpose of this acquisition is to enable flexible capital policy execution in response to changes in the business environment. The buy order is structured to match sell orders from the market, and results will be disclosed following the close of trading. Market conditions may result in partial or non-execution of the planned purchase.
